meta.note: Published dam capacities and gate data. city-of-record style compilation; each figure carries its source URL. Null = not stated in the sources used.
meta.integrity: Every non-null figure carries its source URL. verify_status=verified means a human checked the source page in this session (Mettur as of 2026-10-17); 'compiled, not re-checked' figures were gathered by an automated pass and should be treated as leads until the page is opened. Where a source publishes only MCM or acre-feet the TMC field is null rather than converted, because conversion would be an inference.

dams.name: Mettur Dam
dams.notes: Checked by hand against the dam specification board (via Wikipedia): maximum level 120 ft, maximum capacity 93.47 tmcft = 2,146,071 acre-ft = 2.64 km3. The same article cites CWC 'Compendium of Sedimentation of Reservoirs in India' (2020), List of Reservoirs sl.no 297: capacity as of 2004 = 1,994.19 MCM = 70.5 tmcft after siltation. The commonly quoted figure of 120 is the full-reservoir LEVEL in feet, not a capacity. Live storage is not published for Mettur in the sources used, so live_tmc stays null.

dams.name: Bhakra Dam / Gobind Sagar
dams.notes: gross_tmc 266.70 from Wikipedia (7.551 million megalitres). live_tmc is null because the same page gives live storage only as 6.007 million megalitres with no TMC figure published; converting was not done. Official cross-check: Ministry of Jal Shakti / CWC India WRIS page (https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india) lists Bhakra Dam with Design Gross Storage Capacity 9867.84 MCM, length 518.16 m, max height above foundation 167.64 m - published in MCM only, so it is corroboration, not a TMC source. gate_count 4 is the prose 'four spillway gates' on Wikipedia; the official BBMB page (https://bbmb.gov.in/bhakra-hi.htm) is JavaScript-driven and states no gate count or storage figure in its served HTML. gate_capacity_cfs and max_ow_level_m: not found.

dams.name: Hirakud Dam
dams.notes: live_tmc 205.56 is the page's own '(OR) 205.56 tmc ft (effective)' figure. gross_tmc is null: the same page gives gross only as 8.136 km3 and live as 5.818 km3, with no gross TMC value published. gate_count 34 = the 34 crest-gates; the same infobox field also lists 64 sluice-gates, which are excluded because the field definition excludes sluices. spillway_capacity is published as 42450 m3/s (not cfs) so gate_capacity_cfs is null per the 'keep the published unit' rule. Dead storage level RL 179.830 m is published but is the dead storage level, not the maximum observed/FRL, so max_ow_level_m is null. reservoir_area_km2: not stated on the page used (source not recorded). A separate reporting page states the reservoir has lost 24% of holding capacity to siltation but gives no tmc figure.

dams.name: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam
dams.notes: Two different gross figures on the same page: the infobox states 405 Tmcft while the technical-details list states 'Gross storage capacity at FRL: 312 TMC' (sourced to Deccan Chronicle, 18 June 2018, 'Nagarjunasagar dam loses 25 per cent storage'). Kept 405 because it is the design/headline figure and 312 is the post-siltation current value; both are recorded here. The prose also gives gross as 11.472e9 m3. live_tmc 244.41 is cited by Wikipedia to Central Water Commission, National Register of Large Dams 2009. gate_count 26 = '26 flood gates which are 42 ft wide and 45 ft tall'. max_ow_level_m 179.83 is published as 'Full Reservoir Level (FRL): 179.83 m msl'. reservoir_area_km2 285 is 'Water spread area at FRL'. outlet_capacity_cfs is null: only canal capacities are published (both Jawahar canal and Lalbahadur Shastri canal at 311.5 cumecs), which is cms and is canal rather than outlet capacity. Official cross-check: https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india lists Nagarjuna Sagar Dam at 11553 MCM design gross storage, length 4865 m, max height above foundation 124.66 m (MCM only). MDDL of river sluices published as 137.3 m msl.

dams.name: Srisailam Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc 216 from 'gross storage capacity of 216 tmcft' (dam height on the same page is cited to Central Water Commission, National Register of Large Dams 2009). live_tmc null - no active/live storage figure published on the page used. reservoir_area_km2 616 published as reservoir surface area. outlet_capacity_cfs 44000 is the published design capacity of the Srisailam Right Main Canal in ft3/s at Srisailam reservoir level 269.22 m MSL; it is an irrigation canal carrying capacity, not a dam outlet, and no separate outlet/tailrace figure was found. max_ow_level_m is null: 269.22 m MSL is quoted only as the reservoir level assumed for canal design, not stated as maximum water level or FRL. spillway_capacity is published as 38369 m3/s (cms), so gate_capacity_cfs is null. Official cross-check: https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india lists Srisailam (N.S.R.S.P) Dam at 8724.88 MCM design gross storage, length 512 m, max height above foundation 145 m (MCM only). No spillway gate count published.

dams.name: Sardar Sarovar Dam
dams.notes: Best official coverage of the set. gate_count 30 is from SSNNL: 'For Auxiliary spillway Radial gates, 7 in number and size 60' x 60' ... and for service spillway, 23 Radial gates of size 60' x 55''. gate_capacity_cfs 3000000 is SSNNL's 'spillway discharging capacity of 85,000 cumecs (30 lac cusecs)' - the cfs figure is the published '30 lac cusecs' read out; the same SSNNL page also gives the 85,000 cumecs equivalent, which was not converted. Note SSNNL's own spillway total (30 lakh cusecs) and Wikipedia's spillway_capacity of 86,944 m3/s are not the same published number; the cfs field follows SSNNL because it is the official page and is already in cfs. max_ow_level_m 140.21 is SSNNL's 'The Maximum Water Level is 140.21 meters (460 feet.)'; SSNNL also gives FRL at RL 138.68 m (455 ft) and MDDL 110.64 m (363 ft). gross/live TMC come from Wikipedia (9.460 km3 / 334.12 tmc ft and 5.760 km3 / 203.44 tmc ft) because SSNNL publishes storage only as 0.95 M ha.m (7.7 MAF) gross, 0.58 M ha.m (4.75 MAF) live and 0.37 M ha.m dead. reservoir_area_km2 375.33 = SSNNL's submergence at FRL of 37,533 ha, which matches Wikipedia's res_surface. SSNNL also lists 10 temporary construction sluices and 4 permanent river sluices at RL 53.0 m, excluded from gate_count.

dams.name: Tehri Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc 125.03 from '3.54 km3 (125.03 tmc ft)'. gate_count 2 is Wikipedia's spillway_count for the gate-controlled spillway. spillway_capacity published as 15540 m3/s (cms) so gate_capacity_cfs is null. Official cross-check: https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india lists Tehri Dam, Bhagirathi, Pratapnagar, Tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, completed 2005, length 575 m, max height above foundation 260.5 m, Design Gross Storage Capacity 3540 MCM (MCM only, so no TMC). live_tmc, max_ow_level_m and outlet capacity: not found.

Reservoir catchment published as 61,642 km2. NEDA (neda.gov.in / neda.nic.in) did not resolve from this network, so no NEDA page could be cited. max_ow_level_m and outlet capacity: not found.

dams.notes: gross_tmc 34.84 (987,000,000 m3), live_tmc 10.54 (299,000,000 m3), inactive 688,000,000 m3. gate_count 23 = '23 radial gates (20 m x 18.037 m)'. spillway_capacity published as 88,315 m3/s (cms) so gate_capacity_cfs is null. reservoir_area_km2 93.36 published as res_surface. catchment 64,880 km2. dams.name: Ranjit Sagar Dam (Thein Dam)
dams.state: Punjab (dam on the Punjab / Jammu & Kashmir border)

Official corroboration exists but in MCM: https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india lists Ranjit Sagar Dam (Ravi, Pathankot, Kathua, Punjab, completed 1999, Earthen) at length 617 m, max height above foundation 145 m, Design Gross Storage Capacity 3280 MCM. dams.name: Harike Barrage / Harike Wetland
dams.notes: outlet_capacity_cfs 29000 is the published total carrying capacity of the Harike headworks' Ferozepur, Indira Gandhi Canal and Makku feeder canals, given in cuft/s. This is an irrigation canal carrying capacity, not a dam outlet or tailrace figure; no outlet-specific capacity was found, so read this field with that caveat. gross_tmc and live_tmc: not found - the page publishes no storage capacity for the barrage headworks. reservoir_area_km2 is null because the wetland area is published as 4100 ha (and the bird sanctuary as 8600 ha); converting hectares to km2 was not done. gate_count: the page refers generally to 'sluice gates' being opened during monsoon for sediment flushing but gives no number, so per the field rule it is null. max_ow_level_m: not found.

dams.name: Ram Ganga Dam
dams.notes: State corrected: the dam is at Lansdowne, Garhwal, Uttarakhand, not Uttar Pradesh as listed in the task brief. gross_tmc 8.65 (244,960,000 m3), live_tmc 7.76 (219,600,000 m3). gate_count 5 from 'The dam's spillway is controlled by five gates and has a maximum discharge of 8467 m3/s'. gate_capacity_cfs is null because 8467 is published in m3/s. Official cross-check: https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india lists Ramganga Dam at length 630 m, max height above foundation 127.5 m, Design Gross Storage Capacity 2448 MCM (MCM only). reservoir_area_km2 78.31 published as res_surface; catchment 3134 km2. max_ow_level_m and outlet capacity: not found.

dams.name: Rihand Dam (Govind Ballabh Pant Sagar)
dams.notes: Official source retrieved: U.P. Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd. (https://www.upjvn.org/Home/Rihand) publishes the reservoir as Gross storage capacity 86,00,000 Ac-ft, Live storage capacity 72,00,000 Ac-ft, Dead storage capacity 13,20,000 Ac-ft, Normal full reservoir level 880 ft MSL, Max probable reservoir level 886 ft MSL, Max possible reservoir level 890.80 ft MSL, Dead storage level 775 ft MSL, area submerged at FRL 180 sq miles. Because that page publishes acre-feet and feet, not TMC and not metres, gross_tmc is null and max_ow_level_m is null - no conversion was performed. live_tmc 314.34 is published on Wikipedia as '8.9 billion cubic metres (314.34 tmc ft)'. Wikipedia gives total storage only as 10.6 billion cubic metres and inactive as 1.7 billion cubic metres (60 tmc ft), so gross_tmc has no published TMC value. Official cross-check: https://www.indiawris.gov.in/wiki/doku.php?id=large_dams_in_india lists Rihand Dam at length 932 m, max height above foundation 91.46 m, Design Gross Storage Capacity 10608.32 MCM. Dam height 91.46 m, length 934.45 m. UPJVN publishes 'Max. discharge capacity from penstock: 93.77 cumecs' - that is a turbine penstock rating, not an outlet capacity, and is in cms. gate_count and spillway capacity: not found.

dams.name: Bansagar Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc 191.78 from the infobox 'capacity = 5.43 cubic kms OR 191.78 tmc ft'. The article is very short and publishes no live storage, no spillway data, no gate count, no reservoir area and no water levels, so all of those are null. Published elsewhere: dam length 1020 m, height 67 m, operator Water Resources Department Madhya Pradesh, location Deolond, Shahdol. MP CWRD (cwrdd.gov.in) did not resolve from this network, so no official page could be cited.

dams.name: Kaveri Dam (Mukkadal Dam)
dams.notes: Entry kept because one source page was retrieved, but every field in this schema is null. English Wikipedia has no article titled 'Kaveri Dam'; the dam appears as 'Mukkadal Dam' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mukkadal_Dam) and every capacity, spillway and reservoir field in that infobox is empty. gross_tmc, live_tmc, reservoir_area_km2, gate_count, gate_capacity_cfs, outlet capacity and max_ow_level_m: not found.

dams.name: Kabini Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc 19.52 is explicitly qualified as the ORIGINAL gross storage: 'The Kabini dam is 2284 ft in length with an original gross storage of 19.52 tmcft.' No current live or gross capacity was found. There is no Wikipedia article titled 'Kabini Dam'; the dam is described inside the Kabini River article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kabini_River), so that is the cited URL. gate_count: not found - the page mentions a left bank spillway and notes 'There is an arrangement of lifting and transfer of 28.00 TMC of water during the monsoon months from the kabini dam', but gives no gate or sluice count, so per the field rule it is null. Other published figures: dam length 2284 ft (infobox 12,927 ft) / 696 m, height 166 ft above river bed level, built 1974, catchment area 2,141.90 km2. Spillway discharge capacity, outlet capacity, reservoir area and max_ow_level_m: not found.

dams.name: Bhadra Dam (Lakkavalli Dam)
dams.notes: gross_tmc 71.5 from '71.50 billion cubic feet' - billion cubic feet is the same unit as TMC, so the published number is used as-is. gate_count 4 from 'The dam has four spillway gates. The gate type is not exactly pronounced as either Ogee or Radial.' reservoir_area_km2 is null because the area is published as 11,250.88 ha; converting hectares to km2 was not done. live_tmc: not found. Other published figures: dam length 1708 m, height 59.13 m above river bed level, catchment 1968 km2, left bank canal design discharge 10.76 m3/s. max_ow_level_m, gate_capacity_cfs and outlet capacity: not found. Note: the underlying india-wris reference cited by Wikipedia (india-wris.nrsc.gov.in) no longer resolves.

dams.name: Pochampally Dam (Sriram Sagar / Pochampad, SRSP)
dams.notes: Conflict on the same page, both kept here: the infobox gives total 3,172,000,000 m3 (112.02 tmcft) and active 2,322,000,000 m3 (81.95 tmcft), citing Central Water Commission National Register of Large Dams 2012; the body text says "'Sriram Sagar Reservoir's capacity is 90 tmcft and it has 42 floodgates", citing the (now dead) india-wris SRSP/Pochampad dam record. Kept the infobox 112.02/81.95 for storage because it carries a CWC citation, and kept the body's 42 floodgates for gate_count because no other source gives one. gate_capacity_cfs, max_ow_level_m, reservoir_area_km2 and outlet capacity: not found. Other published figures: 4 turbines of 9 MW each, Kakatiya Canal 346 km.

dams.name: Nizam Sagar Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc 29.72 from the infobox, citing Central Water Commission, National Register of Large Dams, 2019 edition. live_tmc 25.6 from the body text, which also states effective storage as 724.9 Mcm citing CWC NRLD 2012; the same page's technical table independently gives 'A) Gross: 29,716 Mcft. B) Live: 25,600 Mcft.' - consistent with the fields used. The table also gives current reduced capacities: present capacity at +1405 ft is 17,803 Mcft and at MDDL +1376 ft is 786 Mcft. gate_count is null per the field rule: only sluices are published ('Scouring sluice: 9 V. 8'x12'' | Regulator sluices: 11 V.8'x10.5''), with no spillway gate count. reservoir_area_km2 is null because area is published as 56.51 sq miles at MWL. Height of dam above river bed 115.50 ft. max_ow_level_m: not published in metres (only the +1405 ft and +1376 ft levels). Note: the task brief groups 'Sriram Sagar / Nizam Sagar' as one dam; they are two separate structures on the Godavari and Manjira respectively, and are recorded here as two entries.

dams.name: Tungabhadra Dam
dams.notes: Two gross figures published, kept 132: the infobox gives total 3.73 cubic kms (132 tmcft) and active 3.31 cubic kms (116.86 tmcft), while the Technical details section says 'The dam forms the biggest reservoir across the Tungabhadra River with 101 tmcft of gross storage capacity at full reservoir level (FRL) 498 m MSL, and a water spread area of 378 square kilometres', citing the Karnataka government page waterresources.kar.nic.in/salient_features_tungabadra.htm. 101 is kept out of the field but recorded here. reservoir_area_km2 378 also comes from that sentence; the infobox has no res_surface. gate_capacity_cfs 650000 is the published 'spillway_capacity = 650,000 cusecs' - already in the required unit. max_ow_level_m 498 is the published 'FRL 498 m MSL'. gate_count is null: no spillway gate count is published (the page mentions crest gates and spillway shutters in a construction-milestone table but gives no number). Inactive storage published as 2.3 tmcft below 477.01 m msl. Dam length 2449 m, height 49.50 m from deepest foundation (49.39 m elsewhere on the page). The Karnataka official URL cited by Wikipedia was not itself fetched, so it is not used as a field source.

dams.name: Krishnagiri Dam

dams.name: Dantiwada Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc is null because the only published capacity is 907.88 MCM with no TMC value and no live storage. gate_count 11 from the infobox 'spillway_count = 11 (radial) additional spillway 14'; the additional spillway's 14 is a separate structure and is recorded here only as context, so the field holds the 11 radial main spillway gates. gate_capacity_cfs is null because spillway capacity is published as 7504 m3/s (cms). Other published figures: height 61 m, length 4832 m, catchment 40.47 km2. reservoir_area_km2, max_ow_level_m and outlet capacity: not found. Note the infobox catchment of 40.47 km2 looks inconsistent with the West Banas basin; it is recorded as published and not corrected.

dams.name: Maithon Dam
dams.notes: Entry kept because one source page was retrieved, but every field in this schema is null - not found. The Wikipedia infobox res_capacity_total, res_capacity_active, res_capacity_inactive, res_catchment and spillway_count are all empty. The body text discusses carrying capacity but only in vague, internally inconsistent terms ('The carrying capacity of the dam was 1,000,000 cuft/s ... at the time of construction it was only 250,000 cuft/s and at present it has a carrying capacity of less than 100,000 cuft/s'), which is a description of flood discharge rather than a published design spillway gate capacity, so no field was filled from it. DVC (dvc.gov.in), the operator, was not reachable from this network. Other published figures: dam height 165 ft, length 15712 ft, underground Maithon Hydel power station.

dams.name: Panchet Dam
dams.notes: Conflict on the same page: the infobox gives res_capacity_active = 1497.54 million m3 and res_capacity_inactive = 170.37 million m3, while the body text states 'The Panchet Dam has an effective storage capacity of 169,000,000 m3 or 6TMCft', citing Central Water Commission, National Register of Large Dams 2019 edition, project code JH05HH0009. Kept live_tmc 6 because it is the TMC figure and it carries the CWC citation; the 1497.54 million m3 infobox value is recorded here. gross_tmc is null - no gross storage is published. reservoir_area_km2 121.81 is 'the area at maximum conservation pool'; the same sentence also gives 27.92 km2 at dead storage level and 153.38 km2 at top of gates, so the field holds the maximum-conservation-pool value. gate_count is null: the infobox spillway_count is empty. gate_capacity_cfs is null because spillway capacity is published as 17853 m3/s (cms). Other published figures: dam height 45.00 m, length 6777 m, catchment 10961 km2, spillway design flood 17853 m3/s, maximum observed flood (June 1949) 8558 m3/s, spillway crest RL 123.47 m. max_ow_level_m and outlet capacity: not found.

dams.name: Rengali Dam
dams.notes: Entry kept because one source page was retrieved, but every field in this schema is null - not found. River corrected: the dam is on the Brahmani River per Wikipedia, not the Mahanadi as listed in the task brief. gross_tmc is null because the only storage sentence is truncated on the page used ('The dam holds 4400 million cubic' with no unit completing the figure), so the value could not be read without guessing; no live storage is published. reservoir_area_km2 is null because the area is published as 37,840 hectares at full level and 28,000 hectares at mean level; converting hectares to km2 was not done. The infobox res_capacity_total, res_capacity_active and spillway_count are all empty, so gate_count is null. Other published figures: dam height 70.5 m, length 1040 m, catchment 25,250 km2, five turbines of 50 MW.

dams.name: Ghataprabha Dam
dams.notes: gross_tmc is null: the article publishes 'The Ghataprabha Reservoir has storage of about 659 million cubic meters' and, for the third stage, 'raising the Full Reservoir Level to 662.94 meters. This would create gross storage of 1.448 billion cubic meters' - both in cubic metres with no TMC value, and the second is a proposed post-raising figure rather than an as-built capacity. live_tmc, reservoir_area_km2, gate_count, gate_capacity_cfs and outlet capacity: not found. max_ow_level_m 662.94 is the published raised Full Reservoir Level in metres; it is a proposed stage-III level, recorded with that caveat. Note there is no Wikipedia article titled 'Ghataprabha Dam'; the dam is described in the Ghataprabha article. Other published figure: irrigation to 1,396,000 hectares including stage I.
